pretreatments.description: Low-temperature thermal pretreatment (50-80°C for 15-90 min, pilot 70°C for 30 min). This thermal pretreatment was applied to sludge samples to improve hydrolysis and decrease viscosity before anaerobic digestion. It was conducted in stainless steel tubes at temperatures between 50 and 80°C for durations from 15 to 90 minutes, and in a pilot semi-continuous digester using 70°C for 30 minutes as the optimal combination. The treatment aimed to accelerate hydrolysis of organic substances in sludge solids and decrease sludge viscosity, facilitating anaerobic digestion.
